retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast punk aesthetic featuring oversized, cropped white typography against a black background with a single, gritty photographic eye element.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white poster with red accent

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, two-tone composition dominated by a black upper half and massive, white, distressed lettering in the lower half. A single circular cutout reveals a grainy, high-contrast eye, while secondary text is right-aligned in the upper quadrant with a single word highlighted in red.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme scale contrast between massive foreground letters and small metadata text
Figure-ground ambiguity created by cropping large white glyphs against black
Focal point established by a single circular photographic element amidst flat graphics
Triadic color balance of dominant black, secondary white, and a singular red accent
coreInvariants: Distressed or 'chewed' edges on large graphic elements
Right-aligned metadata block in the upper right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Massive white lettering occupies the bottom 60% of the frame, cropped at the edges. A small circular eye is positioned centrally above the letters.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular eye graphic acts as the primary anchor, bridging the black void and the white shapes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right metadata, drops to the central eye, then flows across the large white letterforms at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive black negative space in the upper half creates a sense of tension and weight.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Absolute value contrast (0% vs 100%) with a single high-saturation red point.

letterConstructionRules: Rough, irregular edges suggesting paper cutouts or xerox degradation
Extreme horizontal compression for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the lower half are scaled to be larger than the frame, appearing as abstract shapes

composition.relationshipToImage: forms the base of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed sans-serif for information paired with ultra-bold, distressed sans-serif for graphic impact.

avoid: Clean, sharp edges on the large bottom shapes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy weight of the upper title text.
Provides the thick, blocky foundation for the bottom graphic elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black canvas. In the bottom half, place massive, white, bold sans-serif letter shapes that are cropped by the edges of the frame, giving them a rough, hand-cut paper texture. In the center, place a small white circle containing a high-contrast, grainy black and white image of a human eye.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of right-aligned, condensed white sans-serif text in the upper right corner. Highlight one specific word in the third line with a bold red color.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom text large enough to be abstract?
Is the eye graphic grainy and high-contrast?
Is the top text block strictly right-aligned?
Is there a single red accent word?

adjustableVariables: Amount of edge distress on large letters
Size of the circular eye window
Vertical position of the metadata block
Specific word chosen for red accent
mustRedesign: Original film titles and director names
Exact photographic source of the eye
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no grey tones exist except within the halftone eye
Verify that the large white shapes bleed off the bottom and side edges
Check that the red accent is a pure, vibrant red
Confirm the top text is condensed and uppercase
recipe.reuseFormula: Black background + oversized white distressed shapes at bottom + central halftone circular icon + right-aligned condensed metadata with one red highlight.
